name: banditboard
description: Turn an old Android phone, or just your Windows PC, into a Claude Code usage monitor 🦝

paragraphs: Keep your Claude Code and Antigravity limits in sight: on an old Android phone, your iPhone and Apple Watch, or a widget on Windows and Mac.
Get started · Website · Connect from anywhere · All releases

Banditboard is an always-on display for your AI coding limits: Claude Code, Google Antigravity or both. It shows how much of the 5-hour session and of the week you have used, when each one resets and whether any model has an open incident. Each model is Racco, a pixel-art raccoon who sleeps, sweats, bursts at 100% and dances when music plays.
features: 📊 Usage at a glance: 5-hour session and 7-day week, with a countdown and the local time each one resets

🛰️ Antigravity (new in 1.17.0): the Gemini quota and the Claude and GPT quota of Google Antigravity, each with its 5-hour and weekly window, on the Windows widget and on Android. Follow Claude Code, Antigravity or both

🤖 Claude activity (optional): the project, the branch and what Claude Code is doing right now, and each model's Racco reacts. It works along, shows "…" while commands run, raises a hand with "!" when Claude asks for…

🦝 Racco, the raccoon: one per model (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus and Fable). They blink, wave, sleep when the session is empty, sweat from 85%, turn red from 90% and burst at 100%. Skins, tints and the classic Racco are in the…

🔔 Limit alerts: a notification at 80%, 90% and 100% of the session or the week, and another when it resets. On Android they arrive even with the app closed, and the reset alert goes off on time even with the computer…

whatItDoes.text: Keep your Claude Code and Antigravity limits in sight: on an old Android phone, your iPhone and Apple Watch, or a widget on Windows and Mac.

requirements.text: The numbers come from Claude Code itself, so there is no token or login to hand over.
🖥️ Web dashboard: the Android app's view in your PC browser, on the local network, with PIN login
